messages:
monitoring-bot: ALERT — GPU pool 'eu-west-hotpath' util 96% for 7m, queue length rising (currently ~9.8k). 429 rate up from 0.2% -> 12% in 3m. Paging on-call @mia :fire:

mia: oncall here, seeing the page. starting triage. which tier is hitting 429s?

monitoring-bot: affected routes: /v1/generate (prod-tier), /v1/chat (prod-tier). Token-bucket drops correlate with burst window. sample log: `429 :: /v1/generate :: token_refill=0.5/s :: backlog=9800`

sarah: I can pull tokenbucket metrics and autoscaler logs. patching them now.

sarah: tokenbucket dump for prod-tier:
```
burst: 0
rate_per_sec: 50
max_tokens: 1000
window_ms: 1000
```
weird — burst=0 looks wrong for prod-tier (should be 2000).

mia: that explains sudden 429s under brief spikes. who changed the ratepolicy?

deploy-bot: deploy 1769987201 applied by ops_lead at 1769987400 — modified rate-policy for prod-tier (PR #4123).

ops_lead: that PR attempted to enforce stricter steady-state for beta traffic. I thought it targeted beta-tier only. Investigating why prod-tier changed.

darpan: autoscaler logs show repeated scale attempts hitting `quota_limit: max_gpus=120` then failing. pool size currently 118. scale attempt +16 rejected.

infra-bot: cluster quota enforced by cloud-account 'redwood-prod-eu' — current hard limit 120 GPUs. Request to cloud ops required to raise to 200.

mia: immediate mitigation plan: 1) revert prod-tier tokenbucket to previous burst; 2) open emergency scale override to allow burst to 150 GPUs; 3) apply temporary per-client leaky-bucket so VIPs not 429'd. who can revert the PR?

ops_lead: reverting PR now. rolling back ratepolicy change.

deploy-bot: revert started (revert PR #4123) — progress logs: `revert apply -> config reload -> tokenbucket updated`

sarah: tokenbucket now shows:
```
burst: 2000
rate_per_sec: 500
max_tokens: 2000
```
queue dropped from 9.8k -> 4.2k over 2m but still elevated. 429 rate down to 6%.

darpan: opened cloud ticket to increase GPU quota; support responded ETA ~35m. requesting emergency override in infra console — @infra-team please approve.

infra-bot: emergency GPU override toggle requires two infra approvers. @alice can you approve?

alice: approving override, enabling burst capacity +32 GPUs (temp). :thumbsup:

infra-bot: override applied. pool size now 150. autoscaler resumed. backlog started draining. 429s -> 1.2% over last 3m.

customer-success: any customers impacted? we need messaging.

mia: initial impact: ~2.7% of production requests saw 429 between 11:02-11:14 UTC. top affected customers: AcmeCorp (high), DevSuite (medium). CS, please prepare short note: what happened, mitigation, ETA for full recovery.

customer-success: drafting message. will include suggested retry guidance (exponential backoff, jitter) and mention no data loss.

darpan: long-term root cause candidate list: 1) accidental prod-tier policy change in PR #4123 (owner: ops_lead) 2) autoscaler quota boundary not handled gracefully (scale attempts suppressed without fallback) 3) lack of emergency single-approver override for critical spikes.

ops_lead: own the accidental config change — my PR used a shared config template and the selector matched prod-tier accidentally.

mia: immediate action items (logged):
- revert PR (done)
- temp GPU override (done)
- add safe-guard to autoscaler to fallback to region-burst when quota blocks (owner: darpan)
- add PR gating test to ensure ratepolicy changes need explicit tier match (owner: ops_lead)
- customer notifications (owner: customer-success)

mia: any other mitigations we should apply now?

sarah: recommend we add a temporary route-level soft-limit that converts 429 -> 202 with queue token to avoid client errors for a short window. but that risks queue growth — want a 2nd opinion.

darpan: prefer to avoid 202 for prod. instead, enable prioritized VIP bypass for top 5 customers for 30m. less customer-visible impact.

customer-success: VIP bypass applied to AcmeCorp & DevSuite, monitoring shows their error rates back to baseline.

monitoring-bot: RECOVERY — GPU pool util dropped to 64%, queue length 420, 429 rate <0.5% for 3m.

mia: handing off to darpan for mitigation follow-up and postmortem. if anything regresses ping this thread.

darpan: took handoff. will file postmortem with timeline, diffs, and action items. scheduling a config hardening doc review tomorrow 16:00 UTC.

ops_lead: sorry for the regression. will pair with darpan on the PR gating fix.

customer-success: sent inbound messages to impacted accounts with root-cause summary and expected follow-ups.

mia: closing on-call for this incident. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
